in_hebrew.name: חדווה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Hedva is derived from the Hebrew word 'חדווה' (chaduwah), which means 'love, kindness, affection'. This beautiful name is a reflection of God's endless love and kindness towards His people.

in_greek.name: Ἑδύων
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hedva in Greek is transliterated as 'Ἑδύων'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'ἕδυω' (hedyō), which means 'easy, gentle, pleasant'. This name carries a sense of comfort and tranquility, reminding us of the gentle nature of God.

in_latin.name: Hedviga
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hedva in Latin is transliterated as 'Hedviga'. This name is derived from the Latin word 'videre' (to see), and 'guide' or 'leader'. This name carries a sense of guidance and leadership, reminding us of God's guidance in our lives.
